faq.answer: ENTJ may calibrate strategy through organized action, while INTJ may first build a long-term internal model. The distinction concerns how strategy enters reality, not leadership strength.
faq.question: What is the main difference between ENTJ and INTJ?

faq.answer: Both may be goal-oriented and hold high standards. ENTJ may revise a route through organizational feedback, while INTJ may revise it through independent analysis.
faq.question: Why are ENTJ and INTJ easy to confuse?

faq.answer: In a project crisis, ENTJ may first reset responsibilities and pace, while INTJ may first confirm the root cause and long-term consequences. Both responses can be useful.
faq.question: How might ENTJ and INTJ differ at work?

faq.answer: Do not infer ENTJ from forceful speech or INTJ from quiet behavior. Repeated responses to uncertainty provide more useful evidence than a single visible trait.
faq.question: What is a common mistake when comparing ENTJ and INTJ?

faq.answer: No. It is a limited preference lens. Important decisions still require evidence about skills, experience, values, constraints, environment, and long-term feedback.
faq.question: Can this comparison decide a career or relationship choice?

sections.title: The main difference

rows.ENTJ: Mobilize resources, assign ownership, and set the pace
rows.INTJ: Build the model, filter noise, and choose a direction

rows.ENTJ: May push others to execute too quickly
rows.INTJ: May stay with an internal judgment for too long

rows.ENTJ: Put the issue directly on the table
rows.INTJ: Filter out irrelevant information before speaking

rows.ENTJ: Give the team room to understand the reasoning
rows.INTJ: Externalize key judgments in time for others to respond
